text: Hi, I'm ready. What shall we talk about?
My last question was about Hi I'm ready What shall we talk. Start with one simple idea.
What do you want to talk with me?
Lovely question — we usually say “talk about” instead of “talk with me” here. . What have you been up to lately?
You were saying What do you want to talk with. Could you say a little more about that?
What do you mean? I can't easily get your. I I'm not understand. I mean.
我意思是：英语里我们通常说 “I don’t understand” 或 “I can’t get you”. What were you trying to say?
You mother bitch! What are you talking about? What are you fucking talking about?
Calm down — in British English, just say “What on earth are you talking. about?” What happened?
